field_map.s: FRED series id (entity key; defs in server/fredMacro.ts FRED_SERIES)
field_map.d: observation date (the period the value describes)
field_map.v: value as published at fetch time (numeric; FRED '.' missing values are skipped)
field_map.rt: as-seen date (UTC day WE fetched it) — point-in-time vintage key

confidence_model: official statistics as published; FRED revises history silently — a revision appends a NEW row (same s+d, new v, new rt), never overwrites. 'What was known on day X' = filter rt <= X. Recording forward builds the ALFRED-style vintage archive for free (BUILD-FIRST #2).
cadence: 6h poll (daily series publish once per business day; extra cycles catch weekly/monthly releases and revisions); dedup by (s,d,v)
_note: Universal archive envelope (approved 2026-07-04): dataset-level manifest; datum-level fields where information varies per record. Append-only JSONL unless stated; readers pick field_map from here.
